# ezghcloud_certificate (Resource)

A public TLS certificate. Creating it waits until it is issued; the domain authorizations must be verified by then.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ezghcloud_certificate" "example" {
  project_id               = var.project_id
  name                     = "example"
  dns_names                = ["example.com", "*.example.com"]
  domain_authorization_ids = [ezghcloud_certificate_domain_authorization.example.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dns_names` (Set of String) Names the certificate covers; each needs a domain authorization. Changing them replaces the certificate.
- `domain_authorization_ids` (Set of String) Domain authorizations (dau_) that cover dns_names. Changing them replaces the certificate.
- `name` (String) Name, 1 to 100 characters.
- `project_id` (String) Project identifier. Changing it replaces the certificate.

### Optional

- `key_algorithm` (String) ecdsa-p256 or rsa-2048. Defaults to ecdsa-p256. Changing it replaces the certificate.
- `renewal_enabled` (Boolean) Renew the certificate automatically. Defaults to true.
- `tags` (Map of String) Resource tags.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) Operation timeouts as durations such as 45m. Both default to 30m. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `active_version` (String) ID of the version being served, or null before the first issuance.
- `id` (String) Certificate ID (crt_).
- `status` (String) Issuance status: pending, issued, failed or deleting.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) How long to wait for issuance. Default 30m.
- `delete` (String) How long to wait for deletion. Default 30m.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ezghcloud_certificate.example prj_xxxxxxxxxxxx/crt_xxxxxxxxxxxx
```
